name: CCI MACD Scalper
summary: This EA is a scalping strategy that combines CCI zero-line crossover signals with MACD histogram crossover confirmations and EMA34 trend filtering to generate buy/sell entries. It uses fixed risk-reward ratio position sizing based on account balance percentage and recent swing high/low for stop loss placement. An optional trailing stop mechanism with partial profit taking is also included.
summary_zh: 该EA是一种剥头皮策略，结合CCI零线交叉信号、MACD柱状图交叉确认以及EMA34趋势过滤来产生买入/卖出入场信号。它基于账户余额百分比的固定风险回报比进行仓位计算，并使用近期摆动高低点设置止损。还包含可选的移动止损和部分获利平仓机制。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用CCI指标从超买/超卖区域穿越零线时产生的动量反转信号，同时要求MACD柱状图也出现相应的交叉确认，以确保多指标共振入场。入场条件方面，做多要求价格在EMA34上方（趋势过滤）、CCI从负值穿越到正值（动量反转）、MACD柱状图在零轴下方发生金叉（确认）；做空则反之。出场条件包括基于近期5根K线最低/最高价的止损、基于风险回报比计算的目标价，以及可选的移动止损机制（首次移动时平半仓锁定部分利润）。仓位管理使用基于账户风险百分比和止损距离的动态手数计算，并考虑了手数步长和最大成交量限制。资金管理方面，用户可设定每笔交易承担账户余额的2%风险，止损距离过小时拒绝开仓，这提供了一定的保护。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is to use CCI zero-line crossover signals from overbought/oversold zones as momentum reversal triggers, while requiring MACD histogram crossover confirmation for multi-indicator confluence entries. For entry conditions, a buy requires price above EMA34 (trend filter), CCI crossing from negative to positive (momentum reversal), and MACD histogram bullish crossover below zero (confirmation); sells are the mirror opposite. Exit conditions include stop loss based on the recent 5-bar swing low/high, take profit calculated from the risk-reward ratio, and an optional trailing stop mechanism that closes half the position on the first trailing move to lock in partial profits. Position sizing uses dynamic lot calculation based on account risk percentage and stop loss distance, accounting for lot step size and maximum volume limits. For money management, users can set each trade to risk 2% of account balance, and trades are rejected if the stop loss distance is below a minimum threshold, providing some degree of capital protection.

parameters.description: 魔术编号，用于标识EA订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number for identifying EA orders

parameters.name: accountRisk
parameters.description: 每笔交易的账户风险百分比

pros: 多指标共振入场（CCI+MACD+EMA），减少假信号
基于账户风险百分比的动态仓位计算，风险可控
设置最小止损距离限制，避免过小止损被噪音扫出
pros_en: Multi-indicator confluence entry (CCI+MACD+EMA) reduces false signals
Dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage keeps risk controlled
Minimum stop loss distance requirement prevents getting stopped out by noise
cons: 移动止损使用NormalizeDouble(sl, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE)是错误的，第二参数应为位数而非价格值
未检查CopyBuffer返回值，指标数据可能无效导致错误交易
做多的takeProfit计算错误：bid + riskReward * (bid - stopLoss)对于卖出应为bid - riskReward * (stopLoss - bid)，代码中第145行用了加号而非减号
timePassed标志在定时器到期后永久重置为true，但EventSetTimer未在OnDeinit中用EventKillTimer清理
没有点差过滤，剥头皮策略在高点差环境下可能亏损
cons_en: Trailing stop uses NormalizeDouble(sl, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE) incorrectly - second parameter should be digits, not a price value
No CopyBuffer return value checking, invalid indicator data could cause erroneous trades

Sell takeProfit calculation on line 145 is wrong: uses bid + riskReward*(bid-stopLoss) which gives a positive value instead of bid - riskReward*(stopLoss-bid), producing an incorrect take profit level
EventSetTimer is not paired with EventKillTimer in OnDeinit, causing potential timer leaks
No spread filter - scalping strategy can lose money in high-spread environments
improvements: 修复takeProfit计算bug和NormalizeDouble误用，添加CopyBuffer返回值检查
添加点差过滤和OnDeinit中的EventKillTimer清理
移动止损逻辑应基于ATR或固定点数跟踪，而非简单加减固定单位
improvements_en: Fix the takeProfit calculation bug and NormalizeDouble misuse, add CopyBuffer return value checks
Add spread filter and EventKillTimer cleanup in OnDeinit
Trailing stop logic should be based on ATR or a proper trailing mechanism rather than simple fixed-unit addition/subtraction

risk_points: 剥头皮策略无点差过滤，高点差环境下止损可能不够覆盖点差成本
takeProfit计算存在bug，卖出订单的止盈可能设置错误导致亏损
移动止损NormalizeDouble误用可能导致止损设置失败
risk_points_en: Scalping strategy lacks spread filter - stop loss may not cover spread costs in high-spread environments
TakeProfit calculation bug for sell orders could set incorrect take profit levels leading to losses
NormalizeDouble misuse in trailing stop could cause stop loss modification failures
